profile.headline: SWE @ Northrop Grumman | UCM CSE Alumni
profile.summary: I am a recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering, currently working as a Software Engineer at Northrop  Grumman. I have a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Embedded Software, and Software Engineering roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Redondo Beach, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Co-Founder/Creative Director
positions.description:
- Led the design, creation, and ideation of all media content distributed by the brand, ensuring alignment with company goals and audience engagement.
- Spearheaded the integration of technology into business operations, enhancing efficiency and scalability.
- Provided cross-functional support across all roles within the company, fostering collaboration and operational success.
- Generated Over 2 Million Views and 5300 followers Across Platforms.

positions.title: Student Technology Consultant
positions.description:
- Help Clients troubleshoot their Software/Hardware issues.   
- Setup Devices for 100+ clients, including software on the devices.   
- Identifying effective solutions and offering explanations to customers and employees.   
- Responsible for creating a good work ethic and being collaborative with coworkers and staff members.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Redondo Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Supported the Milstar Satellite Communications Program with enhancing software for crosslink message testing and validation.
• Parsed through 8000+ lines of Java source code, learning Full Stack Development methodologies, and using Agile Development.
• Analyze SQL, and XML making changes as necessary to add crosslink configurations to existing software.
• Developed sample application using Python and Agile Development for Multi-Satellite message use cases.
positions.insights: Skills: Atlassian Suite · Sourcetree · NetBeans · Python · Java · SQL · XML

positions.title: CTI Accelerate
positions.description:
- Work on Python Problem Solving and possible applications
- Develop an ePortfolio
- Harness teamwork skills and learn how to work in a collaborative environment.
- Learn about Python Libraries and how to use them
- Learn Open Source Development: Quality Engineering
- Learn/Polish Python skills and solve practice problems in Python for around 10 hours/week 
- Participate in 2-hour technical interview practice workshops twice a week

positions.title: Expedition EY
positions.description:
- Chosen from a competitive pool of over 3000 applicants to participate in Expedition EY under the Tech Track
- Virtual gamified program that teaches about the work EY does and how to build the transformative mindsets and tech skill sets to thrive in a tech career.
- Access to accomplish skills-based tasks leveraging the latest technologies, such as machine learning and predictive analytics
-Learned about the long-term value of a career in professional services and acquire job skill training through articles, videos and podcasts within this experience

positions.title: Google CSSI
positions.description:
-Participated in a 4-week intensive computer science summer program for high-achieving students
- Completed an introductory project-based JavaScript processing curriculum taught by Google engineers and configured 15 individual coding projects using concepts such as variables, data types, and functions
-Attended product design, resume development, and software engineering interview workshops
-Delivered a collaborative final project presentation that included a live demonstration to Google employees and community leaders

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Assisted people with registering to vote. 
- I cleaned and helped maintain the new Voting BDM Machines.
- Escorted people to a place that they could vote. 
- Helped people get answers to any questions they had about the Voting machines or about voting.
-Did my best to make everyone feel comfortable about the whole experience.

-Helped to oversee and watch Kids at Local Park for Summer Park Program
- Provided kids with teamwork experience through sports.
- Maintained a healthy and active mental state for the kids by helping serve nutritional foods
